meta.name: chain
meta.description: Replay-chain pattern: seed validation, a replay/work stage, then journal the outcome. Ships CLI-castable with a pipeline work slot.

slots.instruction: [WORK SLOT] Replace 'work-slot' (pipeline) with a replay-source node (config: {runId: "<your-run-id>"}) to replay a previous run's journaled rows. The CLI run's own journal only carries the current run, so replay needs an existing runId from an earlier cast.
